An '''individual''' served in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] at some point during its reign. He was selected as a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] for the ''[[Rogue Shadow]]'', the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] used by "[[Galen Marek|Starkiller]]," the secret apprentice of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="TFUn" /> Sometime before or in [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the pilot was shot in the back and [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Unidentified Corellian gunrunner|gunrunner]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[PROXY]] later told [[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse]], a successor of the late pilot, about the individual's fate.<ref name="TFUn" />

==Behind the scenes==
The pilot was briefly mentioned in [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (novelization)|''The Force Unleashed'' novel]], which was written by [[Sean Williams]] and released on [[August 19]], [[2008]].
